ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels comprise approximately 90% of the visible fluke area, contrasted by a low-intensity black perimeter and localized dark spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white region across both lobes. A thick, low-intensity black band (3-20 pixels) maps the entire trailing edge and distal tips. Five distinct low-intensity focal spots are visible: three on the lower-left lobe and two on the lower-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 70 degrees and a bounding-box depth of roughly 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes of 2-8 pixels along the trailing edge, increasing to high-amplitude irregular protrusions (15+ pixels) at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave curvature following an asymmetrical parabolic arc from the median notch to the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, dark, textured clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Small, isolated dark circular pixel clusters (approx. 5-10 pixel diameter) are visible on the white ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, low-contrast gray linear features (rake marks) are detected diagonally across the left lobe and vertically on the right lobe, breaking the white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Textured, irregular protrusions at both fluke tips indicate heavy bio-fouling or barnacle colonization. Distinctive circular dark marks present on the lower ventral surface.
